title: AI & Automation Engineer

title: AI Agent Engineer (Process Automation & Agentic AI)
description: Popis pracovnej pozícieWe are looking for an AI Agent Engineer to translate identified AI and automation opportunities into working, production-grade solutions. Use cases have been defined at a high level; the next step is to build them — which requires deeper understanding of each process than what is captured today.This is a stakeholder-facing engineering role. You will spend time directly with the colleagues who execute the work — claims handlers, underwriters, operations specialists, back-office teams — because that is where the real specification lives. The quality of those engagements will directly shape the quality of what you ship.What You Will Do Run structured working sessions with end users to understand how the work is actually performed today, including exceptions, manual workarounds, and tacit decision rules Translate that understanding into engineerable specifications — process steps, decision criteria, data sources, edge cases, success metrics Build prototypes and proofs of concept, demo them back to the same end users, iterate Implement AI use cases such as:Data extraction from documents (PDFs)Automated form fillingCase classification and routingDecision supportDocument summarization and transformation Integrate AI solutions with internal systems via APIs Bring successful prototypes to production — scalable, observable, continuously evaluated, and maintainableČo ti ponúkameOd 3 131 EUR/mesiacfrom 3.131€ per month - guaranteed 13th and 14th salary Are you an early bird, or do you prefer a quiet morning? Are you curious about what it might contain? To help you eat healthy and hearty meals, we’ll contribute €9.30 toward each lunch. A €200 cafeteria credit—some appreciate the contribution toward sports, others toward massages, culture, books, or medication.
